name: std::ranges::stride_view<V>::iterator<Const>::base
intro:
Returns the underlying iterator. Let current_ be the underlying iterator.

1) Equivalent to: return std::move(current_);.

2) Equivalent to: return current_;.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Build the view, construct and compare its iterator/sentinel, and traverse it. Internal satisfy helpers are exercised by advancing the public iterator.
